subject: Renewal rollforward: committed GPUs + model mix transition plan
body:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@larkops.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@larkops.com>, procure@larkops.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — baseline + new model usage

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the call today. LarkOps is excited to move forward with Redwood for our next 12‑month commitment. A couple of clarifying points we need to lock down before the procurement team circulates the PO: 

- We plan to shift a portion of traffic from the current 13B model to a new larger 40B model with a 32k context window starting in Q3.
- We also want to add the reranker add‑on for search relevance (expected 15% of requests).
- We need a firm throughput guarantee for peak pages: 220 req/s sustained with 350 req/s burst for 15 minutes.

Can you confirm what committed GPU count/map you recommend to meet the above SLOs, and how that maps to reserved pools vs. burst capacity? Procurement will need a line item for committed GPUs and an estimate for potential overage.

Thanks,
Olivia
--
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform
LarkOps

---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@larkops.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — baseline + new model usage

Olivia —

Appreciate the detail. Based on the initial traffic profile you shared in the call, our recommendation to reliably meet the requested SLOs and the model mix change is: 

- Committed pool: 8 x A40/A100-equivalent GPUs in a dedicated reserved pool (this covers baseline sustained throughput with KV cache and batching tuned for 32k tokens).
- Burst buffer: +3 GPUs for short windows (configured as preserved burst capacity in the contract at an hourly surcharge) to meet the 350 req/s 15‑minute bursts.
- Reranker: architect as a separate small pool (2 x V100/A10 class) attached to the same Dedicated environment — reranker is high QPS but lower token cost; separating it avoids head-of-line issues on generation GPUs.

Operational notes: 
- We’ll include a performance‑based throughput SLA (p95 latency and a monthly uptime % for the committed pool).
- Quantization profile for the 40B model (int8) reduces memory pressure and lets us fit more context or reduce GPUs by ~10% in some scenarios — we’ll validate in a short onboarding run.

Next steps: I’ll attach a draft amendment and a capacity worksheet with the mapping and estimated monthly unit cost. If procurement is okay, we can draft the commit and timeline for the model onboarding run (2–3 weeks).

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_proposal_LarkOps_v2.pdf (proposal + amendment stub)

---
From: Evan Park <evan.park@larkops.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia@larkops.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — baseline + new model usage

Hannah/Olivia —

Thanks for the plan. A few procurement questions we need for the PO: 
1) Will the committed GPUs be billed monthly or annually? Procurement prefers monthly invoicing with an annual commitment contract language.
2) For the reranker, do you have an impact estimate on token billing vs CPU operations? We want to model cost for our finance team.
3) Can we get a firm SLA credit schedule if throughput drops below committed levels?

Also, please add a note about data retention and audit logs for compliance.

Evan
Procurement Manager
LarkOps

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Evan Park <evan.park@larkops.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia@larkops.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — baseline + new model usage

Evan —

Responses inline: 
1) Billing: we support both. Typical structure for Dedicated is an annual commitment term with monthly invoices (you precommit to the pool size and we invoice monthly against that commitment). We can add flexibility in the contract to allow one scheduled scale-up in the first 90 days without penalty.

2) Reranker billing: reranker calls are priced per-inference and are materially smaller token-wise but can increase request volume. For planning assume ~0.06x token bill relative to full generation, but plan for compute headroom (we recommend reserving the small reranker pool listed by Hannah). We’ll provide a line-item example in the PO appendix.

3) SLA credits: we’ll include a standard throughput SLA ladder with credit percentages tied to monthly availability of the committed pool (examples in attached proposal).

Compliance: Redwood will provide audit logs, retention options, and SOC2 attestation copy; attach evidence pack on request.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success — Dedicated
Redwood Inference

Attachment: larkops_capacity_plan.xlsx (capacity mapping + cost scenarios)

---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@larkops.com>, Evan Park <evan.park@larkops.com>, procure@larkops.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — baseline + new model usage

Team —

Thanks for the quick reviews. Action items and proposed timelines: 
- Hannah/Marissa: we’ll update the amendment to reflect 8 committed GPUs + 3 burst and 2 reranker GPUs; include monthly billing with annual commitment language. Deliver by Tue 2027-04-05.
- Mateo: plan a 7‑day onboarding validation run for the 40B (32k) model after contract signature to validate quantization profile and batching. Target start date within 14 days of signature.
- Priyom/Diego: include SLA ladder and audit log retention options in the contract appendix.
- Olivia/Evan: procurement to confirm preferred invoicing cadence and e-signature contact for DocuSign so we can push the amendment.

I’m attaching the two files we discussed; I’ll push a DocuSign envelope once procurement confirms the signer. 

Best,
Hannah
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_proposal_LarkOps_v2.pdf, larkops_capacity_plan.xlsx

---
Notes: thread covers renewal/expansion of Dedicated capacity tied to a model mix change (new larger 40B with 32k context and a reranker add-on). Internal participants are coordinating amendment language, billing cadence, and a short upstream validation run before full production cutover. For procurement: deal id LRK-2027-059.
